_readme: TEMPLATE ONLY — NOT A TRUST LIST. scripts/authority-admission.cjs treats a trust file with _template: true or an empty trusted_issuers as AUTHORITY_TRUST_ABSENT and DENIES.

The real file is release-policy/authority-trust.json. It must be committed by a repository admin who is NOT the release subject (cannot push release tags, does not author the release workflows, does not run the build) through a reviewed pull request.
It must NOT be generated, copied or edited by any script, workflow or tool. No script in this repository writes it; the gate only reads it.
trusted_issuers: identities allowed to issue np-authority/1 objects. Each must be different from every reviewer and from every subject principal.
issuer_keys: for every trusted issuer, its Ed25519 PUBLIC key as PEM (SPKI). Private keys never enter the repository, CI, or any variable/secret.
allowed_reviewers: identities allowed to approve the protected deployment; must not overlap trusted_issuers.
consumed_nonces: the single-use ledger. After every ADMITTED release the admin appends that authority's decision_nonce here via reviewed PR; the gate never writes it.
accept_synthetic_authorities must stay false: FORENSIC_SYNTHETIC_ONLY objects are for tests only and are rejected in production.
